title: finding(layout): `AppSchemaRenderer`'s mobile tab bar (`mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'`) hand-rolls nav hrefs instead of calling `resolveHref` — a record deep link, `filters`, `runAction` and a `metadata:*` component entry open the wrong page
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a).
`reach:` measured at the published export `AppSchemaRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`), which is registered as the SDUI node `app-schema-renderer`; its `mobileNavMode` input publishes `bottom_nav`.

## Measured

The objectui#11197 dev measured this in patch round 1 of PR objectui#11207 (report `5911338790`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), at objectui `c148d417b`. It was a scratch test, deleted uncommitted: `AppSchemaRenderer` with `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'` and `basePath: '/apps/crm'`, each tab's href compared with `resolveHref(item, '/apps/crm')`.

| entry | tab href | `resolveHref` (what the sidebar opens) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_user', recordId: 'u1' }` | `/apps/crm/sys_user` | `/apps/crm/sys_user/record/u1` |
| `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'task', filters: { status: 'open' } }` | `/apps/crm/task` | `/apps/crm/task/data?filter%5Bstatus%5D=open` |
| `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'task', runAction: 'task_create' }` | `/apps/crm/task` | `/apps/crm/task?runAction=task_create` |
| `{ type: 'component', componentRef: 'metadata:resource', params: { type: 'object' } }` | `/apps/crm/component/metadata/resource?type=object` | `/apps/crm/metadata/object` |

So the same navigation entry opens a different page on the mobile tab bar than in the sidebar. A record deep link lands on the list, a filtered entry drops its filter, a quick-action entry drops its action, and a metadata-resource entry goes to a component route.

## Site

`packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` `MobileBottomNav` spells the `object` / `dashboard` / `page` / `report` / `url` / `component` hrefs itself. `resolveHref`'s own docblock (`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`) requires every surface to use it. PR objectui#11207 delegates only the `doc` type to it, and leaves the rest as they are.

The console's own shell does not mount `AppSchemaRenderer`: it has no consumer under `apps/console/src` or `packages/app-shell/src`. So the door is an SDUI page, or a host that uses the export.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- `MobileBottomNav` takes every tab's href from `resolveHref`, with the same `basePath` and template context the sidebar passes. ⛔ Not a second copy of its branches.
- Pins: the four rows above, each tab href equal to `resolveHref`'s answer; an ablation for each.
- Order: after PR objectui#11207 lands, which edits the same `MobileBottomNav` block (its `doc` branch).

## Reader and dedupe

- Reader: triage grades it (first touch); then the `domain:ui` execution seat that dispatches it.
- Dedupe, searched just before filing over objectstack-ai/objectui issues, open and closed:
  - `MobileBottomNav bottom_nav tab href resolveHref recordId filters runAction`: 3 hits (objectui#2333, #2272, #2257), all closed, none about the tab bar;
  - `mobile bottom navigation tab bar links wrong href AppSchemaRenderer mobileNavMode`: 8 hits, all closed. The nearest, objectui#3985 (the `mobileNavMode` input's declared type), is a different defect.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) at the review of PR objectui#11207. ⛔ Not graded here.
